fields.label: Project reference
fields.description: Exact authoritative project resource identity whose task relations and document body will be reviewed.

fields.label: Status date
fields.description: Private exact calendar date covered by the proposed status entry; relative date phrases are not accepted.

fields.label: Visibility
fields.description: Portable audience classification allowed by the selected Projects policy.

fields.label: Project health judgment
fields.description: Required human judgment for the status headline. Automation checks it against exact task and milestone contradictions but never invents it from task counts.

fields.label: Health milestone titles
fields.description: Optional private exact milestone-title set whose health tags should be changed to support the human judgment. Every title must resolve once in the current project document.

fields.label: Operator note
fields.description: Optional private operator intent; Core fingerprints it for the receipt and never stores or projects the raw value.
